message.subject: Completing Epson's outdoor graphics solution
message.body:
Hi Jason,

I've been following Epson's push into premium outdoor applications with the S9170 launch. Really impressive positioning.

One thing I've noticed across the industry—printer manufacturers like Epson invest heavily in weather-resistant capabilities, but the actual longevity in the field depends entirely on whatever overlaminate the customer chooses. That gap between your equipment's potential and real-world performance seems like a missed opportunity.

We work with companies looking to offer complete validated systems (similar to how you've partnered with ONYX and Graphtec). Would it make sense to explore technical validation showing how our protective films perform with UltraChrome inks? Could give your reseller network something concrete to recommend.

Happy to send over some technical details if this resonates.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Epson markets weather-resistant outdoor durability but doesn't control the protective film layer that actually determines graphic longevity in the field
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Solution completeness through validated system partnership (similar to existing ONYX/Graphtec model) that enables reseller confidence and competitive differentiation
